text.en:
Section nineteen of Republic Act Numbered Forty-one hundred and thirty six otherwise known
as the Land Transportation and Traffic Code, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 19. Duty to have license. Except as otherwise specifically provided in this Act, it shall be unlawful for
any person to operate any motor vehicle without having in his possession a valid license to drive a motor
"The license shall be carried by the driver at all times when operating a motor vehicle, and shall be shown
